title: Seshadri Family · Greece 2027
eyebrow: Suites With Keith · Your itinerary, the Seshadri family
meta: June 26 to July 9, 2027 · Two adults, two girls · Thirteen nights
intro: Three nights at Cali on Mykonos, a private yacht to Paros for four nights at Parilio, then Andronis Arcadia on Santorini and three last nights at One&Only Aesthesis on the Athens Riviera. All four hotels are booked.
route_title: Four stays, each with room for the girls
route_note: All four hotels are booked. Drivers meet you at every port and airport, and Cali looks after your Mykonos transfers.
days_intro: The yacht, the ferry, the Athens flight and the transfers are arranged through Original Senses, my partner in Athens.

days.title: Land on Mykonos
days.note: Fly in through Athens. Cali's team meets you at the airport and takes you to the hotel.

days.title: Cali, three nights
days.note: Its own beach below the suites, on the quiet east coast.

days.title: Mykonos to Paros on a private yacht
days.note: A Sunseeker Manhattan 60 with captain and host, swim stops on the way and your luggage on board. Cali takes you to the port.

days.title: Parilio, four nights
days.note: Just outside Naoussa, with Cosme's beach club yours at no charge.

days.title: Paros to Santorini on the Blue Star Delos
days.note: One of the big conventional ferries that carry cars, so the crossing is far steadier. Leaves Paros at 11:45AM and arrives Santorini at 2:50PM, business seats for four.

days.title: Andronis Arcadia, three nights
days.note: A private pool, the ARCADemy kids club and the caldera.

days.title: Fly Santorini to Athens
days.note: Aegean, booked on the 6:00AM departure. The time can move to a later flight so the girls are not up before dawn; tell me what suits. A driver meets you in Athens.

days.title: One&Only Aesthesis, three nights
days.note: Bungalows running down to the water on the Riviera.

img.caption: Cali, on the quiet east coast at Kalafatis

stays.headline: Cali, a beach of its own on the quiet side
paras: Cali is one of Greece's great independent hotels, on Mykonos's quieter east coast at Kalafatis. Service is refined, the infinity pool is one of the largest in Greece with real space between loungers, and the beach sits directly below the suites, so the girls can run between room and sand.
Town is 20 minutes away, with a scheduled shuttle to Mykonos Town and Ano Mera from 11AM to 1AM.

card.label: Your stay · 3 nights
card.perks: A complimentary boat transfer to a South Coast beach club (Nammos, Scorpios, Spilia and more), a $100 property credit, breakfast, a welcome bottle of sparkling Greek wine and fruit, early check-in or late check-out when available, and semi-private airport and port transfers to and from Cali.

img.alt: The pool courtyard at Parilio, Paros
img.caption: Parilio, just outside Naoussa

stays.headline: Parilio, the design one, with a beach club next door
paras: As a design lover, Parilio was perhaps my favorite stay in the Cyclades. The light moving through it at twilight is magical, and the staff get to know you and your preferences by name.
Guests can use the beach club at sister hotel Cosme for free, five minutes away by the shared shuttle, so you get the beach without staying on it.

card.label: Your suite · 4 nights
card.perks: An upgrade at check-in when available, a $50 food and beverage credit, a welcome amenity and a cocktail each at the Parilio bar.
card.fine: Free cancellation until 21 days before arrival.

stays.headline: Andronis Arcadia, built for families on the caldera
paras: Arcadia is a true resort rather than a boutique hotel, just outside Oia with sunset-facing suites and very private layouts. Every room has its own pool, some of the largest on the island.
The family side is real: the ARCADemy kids club and the Evexia Spa give the girls and the two of you somewhere to be at the same time.

stays.headline: One&Only Aesthesis, a slow finish on the Riviera
paras: A full seaside resort rather than a city hotel: bungalows and villas running down to the water in Glyfada, an easy run to the airport for the flight home.
The Acropolis becomes a morning out rather than the address, and the rest of the days are for the beach.

card.label: Your bungalow · 3 nights
rows: Aesthesis Bungalow, 41 sqm, two queen beds, private pool, garden view
card.perks: Stay three, pay two. An upgrade on arrival when available, daily breakfast, a $100 resort credit and early check-in or late check-out when available.
card.fine: Free cancellation until June 21, 2027. Climate tax of €15 per room a night, paid at checkout.

next_title: Your hotels are booked. Let's lock in the logistics
next: Pay the deposit to lock in the yacht, ferry, flight and transfers. Original Senses will ask you to sign their agreement on the payment page first.
Pick your yacht for Mykonos to Paros. The Sunseeker is in the price; the Azimut and Aicon are there if you'd rather.
Tell me if you'd like a later Santorini to Athens flight, and send me your flights into Mykonos and home from Athens.
